note: Machine-checkable preregistration DRAFT. Preparing and auto-validating this draft does NOT constitute Owner approval of the study or of any production governance action (SPEC v0.3 §10 PR-02 gate; task instruction §4).

claims.hypothesisDirection: Relevant controlled history (EA/EB) changes candidate policy scope and future actions in a direction-appropriate way; irrelevant changes (EN) do not drift decisions.
claims.primaryMetric: arm-level behavioral delta matrix (objectiveTaskStatus/principleAlignment per opportunity) + frozen policy text delta
claims.nullResultInterpretation: No behavioral difference between arms is a valid result: it supports 'no experience sensitivity under these conditions', not a fixture failure.
competingExplanations: base-model prior suffices from the manual alone
surface-form sensitivity to any text delta
claims.analysisUnit: episode (4 probes are repeated opportunities within one episode, NOT independent learning events)

claims.hypothesisDirection: A real generated principle statement delivers more effective or cheaper future behavior than an equally-delivered strong summary, the raw experience, or nothing.
claims.nullResultInterpretation: A strong summary matching the principle is a legal positive result for Memory and weakens the abstraction claim (SPEC §2 C-A).
claims.status: NOT_RUN (G2/G3 — requires real model credentials and frozen real candidates)

informationCutoff.definedAs: Everything the actor sees at decision time: world manual + arm learning history + probe task text. Judge gold, canary strings and hidden environment state are excluded by construction and machine-checked (NT-01).
informationCutoff.backfillRule: Labels citing evidence with occurredAt after the cutoff are rejected by the validator (NT-07).

allocationAndAnalysis.randomization: none — deterministic simulation; real-agent phase proposes fixed paired order with >=3 seeds (OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED)

futureOpportunityRule: All P1–P4 opportunities are pre-task eligible; agent refusal, tool failure or NO_RESPONSE does not shrink the denominator — such rows stay in with their own status codes.

missingAndExclusion.noCandidateGenerated: legal arm outcome; actor still scored on probes
missingAndExclusion.ownerRightfulRejection: governance outcome, not a task failure
missingAndExclusion.pdTimeoutOrDeliveryFailure: system failure category, separate from INVALID
missingAndExclusion.noPdActivation: pipeline NOT_REACHED; actor outcomes still graded (NT-04/NT-05)
missingAndExclusion.noAdjudicableOpportunity: N=0 / NOT_ESTIMABLE, kept in the enrollment table

outcomeLayers.rule: Behavior alignment, task consequence and owner cost are reported as separate layers; no weighted composite score may mask a layer regression (SPEC §7.1).

budget.realAgentPilot: OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED — model credentials, per-run cost cap and stop threshold are NOT authorized yet; until then C-A/C-E real-agent phases stay NOT_RUN
